description: Retrieve the canonical Swiss commercial-register (Zefix) profile for one company by UID: legal name, legal form, register status, seat, canton, registered address, purpose and official register links, with provenance, attribution and a freshness envelope (evidence age, freshness threshold, stale flag and source state). The UID is normalized and its check digit validated before any source request. FOUND means a register record was retrieved, not that the business passed verification. For sanctions, FINMA and full verification outcomes, use verify_business.

inputSchema.description: Retrieve the canonical Swiss commercial-register (Zefix) profile for one company by UID. Retrieval only: FOUND means a register record was retrieved, not that the business passed verification.

uid.description: Swiss UID (e.g. CHE-116.281.549). Formatting is normalized; the mod-11 check digit is validated before any source request.

name: get_company_profile
title: Get Swiss company profile
